exclusions.name: google go
exclusions.reason: Google Go is Google's lightweight search app (Play Store id com.google.android.apps.searchlite), not the Go language. With the publisher Google, the leading word google is read as Go's vendor and dropped, which leaves the title go. Go rows named Go keep matching.

graalvm-ce.reason: Before 2023 GraalVM numbered releases by calendar year (19.x to 22.x: 20.3.6, 21.3.1, 22.0.0.2, 22.3.3). These cycles are the JDK-based releases from 2023 (21.0.2, 22.0.1). The old 20.x, 21.x and 22.x lines overlap cycles 20, 21 and 22, so an old version would get a cycle with the wrong dates. 20.0.1, 21.0.0 and 22.0.0 exist in both numberings and are left undecided too.

oracle-graalvm.reason: Oracle's GraalVM Enterprise releases before 2023 used the same calendar numbering (20.3.x, 21.3.x, 22.3.0). These cycles are the JDK-based releases from 2023 (21.0.5). The old 20.x, 21.x and 22.x lines overlap cycles 20, 21 and 22, so an old version would get a cycle with the wrong dates. 20.0.1, 21.0.0 and 22.0.0 exist in both numberings and are left undecided too.
